unit.why: A short biographical-hagiographic note, copied from the Hida's Shem ha-Gedolim, about the pre-Hasidic kabbalist R. Eliyahu de Vidas: his books, his move from Safed to Hebron, his burial there, and his soul-root; it is minimal as a narrative but does narrate events.
unit.boundary_note: Opens a new section (אות ד, on studying Reshit Hokhmah); the next division continues the same topic with a further citation.

stories.start_quote: רבינו אליהו די וידאש תלמיד הרמ״ק
stories.end_quote: (שה״ג להג׳ חיד״א מער׳ א׳ אות קנ"ז)
stories.summary_en: R. Eliyahu de Vidas, disciple of R. Moses Cordovero, wrote Reshit Hokhmah and left Safed for Hebron, where he was buried; R. Hayyim Vital reports that he and Cordovero shared the soul of Zechariah son of Jehoiada, which is why they loved each other.

tags.why: It praises a pre-Hasidic Safed kabbalist and is explicitly copied from Shem ha-Gedolim.
It identifies his soul-root and earlier incarnations.
